title: 第733章 一胎十宝术第732章 紫微大帝的演技诛仙剑阵
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 就在叶云以诛仙剑阵跟这些强者们玩玩的时候。
另一边，寰宇万界后续的强者也都出现，跟天庭交战了起来。
喊杀声震天，大道法则崩断，神通法术交织，虚空不断塌陷。
这时，紫微大帝他们也都赶了回来，加入了战场。
紫气席卷，星辰陨落，杀伐之气弥漫八荒。
杨戬、哪吒和孙悟空也在战场之中，他们三个表现最为突出。
毕竟准圣数量并没有很多，而他们三个，号称准圣之下无敌手也不为过。
所以，在战场之中的表现极其亮眼，所过之处，敌人纷纷溃败。
尤其是孙悟空，一边打一边释放不正经神通，这简直就是战场的大杀器。
金箍棒横扫，同时，一道道诡异光芒射出。
所过之处，敌人要么变性，要么变动物，要么变成各种奇奇怪怪的东西。
简直骇人无比，哀嚎遍野，惨叫连连。
别说敌人了，哪怕是天庭这边的自己人，看到孙悟空，也是如避蛇蝎。
“快躲开，那猴子来了！”
“别波及到我，我还不想社死啊！”
“这神通太可怕了，快跑啊！”
如此大的动静，自然引起了天庭高层的注意。
太乙救苦天尊看着这一幕，嘴角一抽，即便道心坚硬如他，此时也有些绷不住。
其他高层也是一样的表情，一个个眼皮狂跳，头皮发麻。
瑶池金母额头冒出黑线。
这要是传出去，天庭的形象岂不是全毁了？
西方那位圣人怎么回事，怎么教这猴子这么不正经的神通？
其他天庭高层显然也是一样的想法，纷纷在心中吐槽准提道人。
准提道人要是知晓这些，怕不是当场赶回来澄清了。
不是我啊，我可是正正经经的一个圣人啊！
而原本老神在在的昊天玉帝，看到孙悟空的不正经神通，却是眼神一亮。
他心中直呼好东西，这才是神通的正确打开方式啊。
以往那些都太过古板无聊了，不够刺激。
昊天甚至暗中记下了几个神通，准备回去研究研究。
至于找孙悟空光明正大的探讨，他可不敢，看看旁边瑶池金母的表情就知道了。
就这样，虽有波澜，但大战还是持续了下去。
content_en:
Just when Ye Yun was playing with these strong men with the Zhuxian Sword Formation.
On the other side, the subsequent strong men from all over the world also appeared and started fighting with the Heavenly Court.
The shouts of killing shook the sky, the laws of the avenue collapsed, magical powers and spells intertwined, and the void continued to collapse.
At this time, Emperor Ziwei and the others also rushed back and joined the battlefield.
Purple energy swept across, stars fell, and the murderous energy filled the wasteland.
Yang Jian, Nezha and Sun Wukong were also on the battlefield, and the three of them performed the most outstandingly.
After all, there are not many quasi-sages, and it is not an exaggeration to say that the three of them are invincible among the quasi-sages.
Therefore, its performance on the battlefield was extremely impressive, and the enemies were defeated one after another wherever it passed.
Especially Sun Wukong, who releases his unorthodox supernatural powers while fighting, is simply a killer weapon on the battlefield.
The golden cudgel swept across, and at the same time, strange rays of light shot out.
Wherever you go, the enemies either change their gender, turn into animals, or turn into all kinds of weird things.
It was simply terrifying, with howls and screams all over the place.
Not to mention enemies, even our own people on the Heavenly side, when they see Sun Wukong, they avoid snakes and scorpions.
"Get out of the way, the monkey is coming!"
"Don't let it affect me, I don't want to die!"
"This magical power is too scary, run away!"
Such a big movement naturally attracted the attention of the higher-ups in Heaven.
Taiyi Jiku Tianzun looked at this scene and twitched the corner of his mouth. Even though his Taoist heart was as hard as his, he still couldn't hold back at this moment.
The other senior executives also had the same expression, their eyelids were twitching wildly and their scalps were numb.
Black lines appeared on the forehead of Yaochi Golden Mother.
If this spreads out, won't the image of Heaven be completely ruined?
What happened to that saint in the West? How could he teach this monkey such unorthodox supernatural powers?
Other high-level officials in Heaven obviously had the same idea, and they complained about Zhunti Taoist in their hearts.
If Master Zhunti knew this, he might not have rushed back to clarify the matter on the spot.
It’s not me, I’m a serious saint!
But when the Jade Emperor of Haotian, who was originally the old god, saw Sun Wukong's unorthodox supernatural powers, his eyes lit up.
He said in his heart that this is a good thing, this is the correct way to unlock magical powers.
Those in the past were too boring and not exciting enough.
Haotian even secretly memorized a few magical powers and prepared to go back and study them.
As for having an honest discussion with Sun Wukong, he didn't dare to. Just look at the expression of the Golden Mother of Yaochi next to him.
In this way, despite the ups and downs, the war continued.
